_comment: Railway service config for the SupaNet control-plane provisioning worker (control-plane/worker). Build context is the REPO ROOT — the engine needs supabase/migrations + supabase/functions from the checkout. Set the env vars from control-plane/.env.example as service variables (SUPANET_MGMT_PAT, RAILWAY_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_PROVISIONING_KEY, CONTROL_PLANE_SUPABASE_URL, CONTROL_PLANE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, …). No public networking needed — it only polls Postgres.
